parameters: harness: outflow from the v_out_sum Sum port (formerly its run value)

invariants.description: Poiseuille resistance and thin-wall compliance: R = 8 mu l/(pi r_0^4), C = 2 pi r_0^3 l/(E h), h = r_0(a e^(b r_0) + c e^(d r_0)) (Avolio wall-thickness fit)
volume conservation: q_C + q_C_d = (v_in - v_out_sum (= vout/v)) t exactly (both start at 0)
exact solution: D = q_C - q_C_d = (v_in + v_out_sum (= vout/v)) (RC/4)(1 - e^(-4t/(RC)))
Ohm law across the vessel: v = (u - u_d)/R = 2(q_C - q_C_d)/(RC)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(v*R, u - u_d, rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-8*np.max(np.abs(u))) & np.allclose(v, 2*(q_C - q_C_d)/(R*C), rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-30)

invariants.description: pressure law: u_C = q_C/(C/2) + u_ext, u_C_d = q_C_d/(C/2) + u_ext, u = u_0 + u_C, u_d = u_0 + u_C_d (fails: the CellML adds a constant 2 Pa, see expected_failures)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(u_C, q_C/(C/2) + u_ext, rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-6) & np.allclose(u_C_d, q_C_d/(C/2) + u_ext, rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-6) & np.allclose(u, u_0 + u_C, rtol=0, atol=1e-6) & np.allclose(u_d, u_0 + u_C_d, rtol=0, atol=1e-6)

invariants.description: total volume q = q_0 + q_C + q_C_d with q_0 = pi r_0^2 l
invariants.expr: np.allclose(q_0, np.pi*r_0**2*l, rtol=1e-9) & np.allclose(q, q_0 + q_C + q_C_d, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-30)

bc_sweep.rationale: BCs span the reference pressure u_0 up to u_0 + 3 dp (dp = test pressure drop of the vessel class) and flows 0 to 3x the equilibrium flow dp/R; u_ext -1000..1000 Pa (tissue pressure); geometry, E, mu and the wall-thickness coefficients at 0.5-2x (the exact solution is re-evaluated at every point, so all invariants must hold across the whole region).

baseline.reason: no single-compartment data: an isolated 0D segment with constant BCs has no measured counterpart. Candidate for a network built from these components: pries1990blood rat-mesentery networks (segment diameters, lengths, measured velocities/pressures), or the boas2008vascular arteriole-capillary-venule chain (60 -> 25 mmHg); not set up
